dashboard.label: Threatfeed History
dashboard.description: Timeline of which threatfeeds asserted each IOC (first/last seen per threatfeed), with filtering by IOC, type, and threatfeed.

input.label: Threatfeed
input.populatingSearch: | inputlookup opencti_threatfeed_history | stats count by threatfeed | sort threatfeed

search.query: | inputlookup opencti_threatfeed_history | where (isnull($type_filter$) OR $type_filter$="" OR type=$type_filter$) | where (isnull($ioc_filter$) OR $ioc_filter$="" OR like(ioc, "%$ioc_filter$%")) | where (isnull($threatfeed_filter$) OR $threatfeed_filter$="" OR mvfind(split("$threatfeed_filter$", ","), threatfeed)>=0) | stats dc(ioc) as IOCs

| inputlookup opencti_threatfeed_history | where (isnull($type_filter$) OR $type_filter$="" OR type=$type_filter$) | where (isnull($ioc_filter$) OR $ioc_filter$="" OR like(ioc, "%$ioc_filter$%")) | where (isnull($threatfeed_filter$) OR $threatfeed_filter$="" OR mvfind(split("$threatfeed_filter$", ","), threatfeed)>=0) | stats dc(threatfeed) as Threatfeeds

chart.title: New IOC flags per day (by threatfeed)

search.query: | inputlookup opencti_threatfeed_history | where (isnull($type_filter$) OR $type_filter$="" OR type=$type_filter$) | where (isnull($ioc_filter$) OR $ioc_filter$="" OR like(ioc, "%$ioc_filter$%")) | where (isnull($threatfeed_filter$) OR $threatfeed_filter$="" OR mvfind(split("$threatfeed_filter$", ","), threatfeed)>=0) | eval first_epoch=if(isnum(first_seen_threatfeed), first_seen_threatfeed, strptime(first_seen_threatfeed, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N%z")) | eval _time=coalesce(first_epoch, now()) | bin _time span=1d | stats count by _time threatfeed

| inputlookup opencti_threatfeed_history | where (isnull($type_filter$) OR $type_filter$="" OR type=$type_filter$) | where (isnull($ioc_filter$) OR $ioc_filter$="" OR like(ioc, "%$ioc_filter$%")) | where (isnull($threatfeed_filter$) OR $threatfeed_filter$="" OR mvfind(split("$threatfeed_filter$", ","), threatfeed)>=0) | eval first_epoch=if(isnum(first_seen_threatfeed), first_seen_threatfeed, strptime(first_seen_threatfeed, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N%z")) | eval last_epoch=if(isnum(last_seen_threatfeed), last_seen_threatfeed, strptime(last_seen_threatfeed, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N%z")) | eval "First Seen (Threatfeed)"=if(isnull(first_epoch), "", strftime(first_epoch, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S")) | eval "Last Seen (Threatfeed)"=if(isnull(last_epoch), "", strftime(last_epoch, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S")) | rename last_score as "Last Score", last_confidence as "Last Confidence" | table ioc type threatfeed "First Seen (Threatfeed)" "Last Seen (Threatfeed)" "Last Score" "Last Confidence"
